name: listai
description: AI-powered property search pipeline for Portugal (Idealista, Imovirtual, Casa Sapo, etc).
_comment: Agent-driven (Markdown modes + YAML config). Shipped scripts use Node built-ins ONLY — zero dependencies, no install: export-xlsx.mjs (CSV/TSV -> XLSX) and scan-browser.mjs (browser scanner). scan-browser.mjs OPTIONALLY uses Playwright if you install it (npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium) — it is NOT a declared dependency, so the core stays install-free. See docs/browser-scanning.md.
